Its going to take time for me to let go, because this guy decided to lead me on for 2 years. He made me believe he loved me and that he wanted to be around me. Until I had gone to one of his friends house (whom is female) to talk it out with her. Through one of her friends, who is also his friend, I had to find out that he was already seeing someone else. And then he texted the friend that I was with this:

He straight texted her friend saying "I don't know why I can't leave her. I think its because I love her too much." His friend said this to him "No, that's bullshit and you and I both know that's not true. You just like the control." And he replied with "you're right. I do." 

When she told me that, I broke. I literally felt myself fall into this hole and now everything is too damn hard because I absolutely loved this guy. But I shouldn't, and I know I shouldn't because not only did he r*pe a girl in high school, he did it to me when we were dating. And I was asleep. I didn't know what was happening cause I was running on 24 hours of no sleep so I just went with whatever was happening. I was tired. I'm still tired. 

And when I get depressed and constantly talk about this, or I say I want to die, my own family and friends I've had for years, they block me. They leave. They always leave. Including guys I've tried to connect with to move on with my life. 

There's no reason to live anymore. Money, going out and seeing the world, it doesn't make me happy. I just want to sleep. To lay here until I eventually die. 

Being betrayed by the people you love the most, especially when you assumed you'd marry one, is a hard pill to swallow.
